Everywhere else is not yet harvested.

projects.name: DIR 204 — HB4 wheat field trial (environmental stress tolerance)
projects.desc: HB4 wheat, OECD unique identifier IND-ØØ412-7. Carries the HaHB4 gene from sunflower for environmental stress tolerance plus the bar gene as a glufosinate-tolerance selectable marker, introduced by biolistic transformation. Up to ten sites per year across wheat-growing areas of New South Wales, Victoria, South Australia and Western Australia, twenty hectares total per year, August 2024 to December 2029. Already approved for commercial cultivation in Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay. Marker sits at a wheat-belt centroid because the trial is multi-state.
